$comment: Screens and actions that moved to the owner of their job or tables (ADR 0025) and keep
naming the atom of the entity they left (Khoa, 2026-11-01). Renaming an atom is a write
to every grant that points at it in production, so it is a later card of its own, with
the explain-first SQL flow. scripts/access-declarations.mjs reads this list; an entry
nothing uses fails, so the list only shrinks.
A.89 (2026-11-10) renamed every carried atom to its owner's name, so the list is empty; a later move that keeps an atom adds its row here again.
